title: Legislative definition — inspect the term and swap it
titleEs: Definición legislativa — Inspección y cambio de un dato
description: The desk after the term was pinned to its definition in another section. A rectangular inset window lifts a real enlarged copy of the term and its pin; the term is replaced by an alternative value (the old one struck through, still readable); back in context only the dependent connection moves — the cord re-pins to the entry that lists the new term, or keeps no far end when none does — and a changed-datum marker stays. Seeking back restores the old datum.

sources.description: Fictional source names: [0] is printed on the book (the full text that holds both sections); [1] names the separate note in which an ordinary use is proposed (scenes that show it) (array replaces the previous value)

hierarchy.description: User-supplied ordering of the divisions of the text, drawn top to bottom as index flags on the book. The order is the author's; the scene implies no rule of precedence between levels (array replaces the previous value)

ref.description: Reference printed on the page, e.g. "Text 1 · Art. 7 (fictional)"

text.description: Simulated wording: for [0] the clause that uses the term; for [1] the definition wording that follows the term

term.description: The term as written in this passage

level.description: Hierarchy level (1 = first flag) that holds the passage

passages.description: Fictional passages: [0] the article in which the term is USED; [1] the section that SUPPLIES the definition (array replaces the previous value)

focusTarget.description: Detail that is enlarged and substituted

beforeValue.description: The term as used in the article before the substitution (the entry at entryRows.before lists it)

afterValue.description: The alternative term substituted in the article (listed at entryRows.after, or by no entry when 0)

zoom.description: Wanted magnification of the inset (bounded by the free space it opens in)

placement.description: Where the inset opens: 'auto'/'left' in the free space under the article extract; 'top' above the documents when there is room; other values fall back to 'auto'

after.description: Row listing the after term (0 = none, 1–3)

entryRows.description: Row of the definitions page (1–3) that lists each value; 0 = no entry lists the new term (the cord then keeps no far end)
